reason: Does not fit. In the shipping build (SKY_MODE, GAMEPLAY_SHIELD=0) sky_edges.6502 is included before the renderer, under 'ASSERT * <= &9000 + PAD_START' (src/main.6502:139). build/strykers.lst: sky_col_zero at &8FCB, its code ends at &8FE3, then 'SKIP &9000 + PAD_START - *' = 29 bytes free, not 110. The candidate grows the code by 38 bytes (old lines 13 bytes; new 51: LDA abs,X 3, EOR# 2, BNE 2, 8x STA (zp),Y 16, 7x DEY 7, INX/CPX zp/BNE/RTS 6, LDA #0 2, STA/DEY/CPY zp/BNE 7, INX/CPX/BNE/RTS 6), so it ends at &9009 and the ASSERT fails; the candidate itself says it runs to &9008, past &9000, which is the renderer's start (render.6502 must start at &9000; &8000-&8FFF is the code under ANDY, ROMSEL &04 only). The opcodes and the cycle count are otherwise right: 65SC12 STA (zp),Y is 6 with no page penalty, old 8-byte row 8*14-1 = 111, new 4+2+2+8*6+7*2 = 70, saving 41; slow rows +11. But it cannot be assembled in this layout without moving code, so refuted.
